Dear Henkel Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Marketing Intern (FMCG) position at Henkel. As a junior digital marketer with a strong analytical mindset and hands-on experience in brand performance tracking, competitor monitoring, and content creation, I am excited about the opportunity to support your Brand Manager in a dynamic FMCG environment.

In my current role at Episto, I manage on-page SEO and keyword-targeted content for client websites, using tools like Google Analytics, SEMrush, and Ahrefs to analyze market data and optimize performance. I have also built and maintained WordPress sites, collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless project execution. My project mirook.com demonstrates my ability to implement structured data and technical audits to improve visibility across search engines.

I am fluent in English, have a B1 level in Dutch, and am eager to contribute to Henkel's diverse and international team. I am available for a 6-month internship starting in June or July 2026.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can add value to your team.

Best regards,

Baver Ok

Dear Henkel Hiring Team,

I have also collaborated closely with cross-functional teams, including sales and planning, to ensure cohesive project execution. I am fluent in English and have a B1 level in Dutch, which I am actively improving. I thrive in high-paced, international environments and am comfortable multitasking and adapting to new challenges. I am available for a 6-month internship starting in June or July 2026.

I am drawn to Henkel's culture of trust and belonging and would be proud to contribute to your leading brands. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can make an impact at Henkel.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok

Baver Ok
Digital Marketing · SEO · GEO · Content · Web
Zwijndrecht, Belgium | +32 470 42 48 36 | baverok@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/baverok

## Profile
Junior digital marketer with a strong analytical foundation and hands-on experience in market data analysis, competitor monitoring, and brand performance tracking. At Episto, I run on-page SEO, keyword-targeted content, and full-cycle WordPress site builds, using tools like Google Analytics, SEMrush, and Ahrefs to guide data-driven decisions. On my own project (mirook.com), I applied structured data and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. Comfortable collaborating with cross-functional teams and external partners, and quick to adapt to new tools and platforms. Based in Zwijndrecht, next to Antwerp. Works in English and Turkish; Dutch: B1, currently taking classes to improve further.

## Core Skills
- Analytics & Reporting: Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Ads
- SEO & GEO: on-page SEO, keyword research, technical SEO audits, structured data / JSON-LD schema, entity optimization, GEO & AEO (AI search visibility)
- Content & CMS: SEO blog & content writing, editorial content publishing, website content management, WordPress site building
- Web & Build: WordPress, Elementor, Astra theme, responsive web design, Canva, AI-assisted content tools
- Social: social media content & integration
- Languages: English (professional), Turkish (native), Dutch (B1)

## Experience

### Junior Digital Marketer — Episto (Remote), 2026–present
- Own on-page SEO for client websites, from keyword research to publishing, improving organic visibility and search rankings
- Write keyword-targeted blog content for client websites to grow organic traffic
- Build and maintain client websites in WordPress using Elementor and the Astra theme, including content uploads and page updates
- Track site performance with SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and Google Ads to guide SEO and content decisions

### Warehouse & Logistics — Katoen Natie (Antwerp), 2025–2026
- Maintained accuracy and efficiency in a high-volume, fast-paced logistics environment

### Front-End Developer — ViviDoctor (Belgium), 2018–2019
- Developed and optimized front-end features for a healthcare web application (AngularJS, JavaScript)

## Projects

### mirook.com — Website Design, SEO & GEO (2025–present)
- Designed and built a multi-page WordPress site (Elementor, Astra) for a Belgian youth chess champion: full site structure, on-page SEO, and social media integration (Instagram/Facebook)
- Implemented structured data (JSON-LD schema, including SportsEvent and FAQPage), entity/knowledge-graph markup, and an llms.txt file to improve visibility across traditional and AI-powered search engines (GEO/AEO)
- Ran iterative technical SEO/GEO audits, measurably raising the site's overall search-health score

## Education
- Karel de Grote Hogeschool, Antwerp — Coursework in Applied Computer Science (2022–2025)
- Celal Bayar University, Türkiye — Coursework in Computer Science (2012–2016)
- Diyarbakır Anatolian High School, Türkiye — High School Diploma (2012)
